principle: Mobile reuses the desktop Prompt Kit data, filters, renderers, and action functions. Responsive behavior may reorganize layout or expose explicit touch controls, but it must not create a second interaction model.

requirements.expected: The main Prompt Kit title/logo is a pointer- and keyboard-accessible reset control that restores All prompts, All Categories, All Types, empty search, closed detail/reference surfaces, and the top of the page.
Every prompt card exposes an explicit Open action so touch users do not depend on double-click or double-tap timing to inspect prompt detail.
The existing Copy action remains visible and touch-sized on coarse-pointer/mobile layouts while desktop single-click copy behavior remains intact.
Library, category, and type filters remain the same controls and semantics; narrow layouts may present them as horizontally scrollable touch rails rather than wrapping into an unstable header.
Narrow layouts render prompt cards in one readable column without horizontal page overflow.
Prompt detail reuses the existing detail surface and functions but occupies the mobile viewport with an accessible close and full-width Copy action.
The existing reference panel remains available and expands to the mobile viewport rather than introducing a separate reference UI.
Top/Bottom links remain present and touch-usable on every visible prompt category without changing active filters.

Open-Latest-PromptKit.cmd provides a zero-dialog normal-user route that resolves Desktop/OneDrive development roots, preserves unsafe existing work, safely syncs canonical main, validates exact Prompt Kit parity, and opens the canonical website.

proof_ceiling: Static source, PowerShell parse, deterministic tests, generated-site parity, and CI prove the tracked responsive/acquisition contract. Physical phone/tablet ergonomics, browser clipboard permissions, touch timing, live OneDrive filesystem state, and Windows process launch remain field acceptance gates.
